latest.name: CATalyst v1.3.17
release_notes: The Windows v1.3.17 download is temporarily withheld because Microsoft Defender currently classifies the installer as Trojan:Win32/Wacatac.B!ml. Do not bypass this alert.
The installed v1.3.17 payload passed Defender, but the public installer remains unavailable while a replacement package is verified.

Fixes startup recovery after an upgrade or forced shutdown leaves an offer publication claim in an ambiguous state. CATalyst now verifies Dexie state, safely suppresses only the exact ambiguous orphan, retires a decisively dead short-lived runtime lease, and continues startup instead of remaining blocked by PUBLICATION_CLAIM_RECOVERY_REQUIRED.
Preserves fail-closed behavior for live owners, unproven owners, malformed evidence, long-lived leases, and uncertain publication state.
